# How to Moisturize Hair with OLAPLEX


Dry, brittle hair can make even the healthiest styles feel lackluster, but learning how to moisturize hair properly can completely change the way your hair looks and feels. From environmental stress and heat styling to chemical services and everyday wear, many factors can strip hair of the moisture it needs to stay soft, shiny, and strong.


Let’s dive into why hair gets dry, how to hydrate hair for lasting health, and how to keep hair moisturized and strong no matter how you style it!


## Why Does My Hair Feel Dry?


Like your skin, hair can become dry for many reasons, some environmental, some lifestyle-related. Over time, these factors can compromise your hair’s ability to retain its moisture, leading to rough texture, frizz, and breakage.


Common causes of dry hair include:


- Environmental factors: Sun exposure, wind, and cold weather can strip moisture from the hair.
- Hard water: High mineral content can leave buildup on the hair, making it harder for moisture to penetrate.
- Heat styling and chemical treatments: Frequent blow-drying, flat ironing, coloring, or bleaching can weaken hair and reduce moisture retention.
- Over-washing: Washing too often may remove natural oils that keep hair hydrated.
- Aging:[As scalp oil production slows over time](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/scalp-treatment-solutions-for-healthy-hydrated-scalp) , hair may naturally become drier. ****


## How to Moisturize Dry Hair in 5 Easy Steps


Moisturized, healthy-looking hair starts with the right routine. Follow these 5 simple steps to help restore hydration while strengthening hair from within.

2. Apply Nᴼ.3PLUS from mid-lengths to ends.

## More Ways to Moisturize Your Hair


Small changes in your daily routine can make a big difference in moisture retention:


- Rinse hair with cool water to help seal the cuticle
- Limit heat styling and always use a heat protectant
- Use a silk pillowcase or bonnet to reduce friction
- Minimize chemical services, like bleaching, coloring, and perms
- Add a leave-in conditioner, such as[N°.5 Leave-In](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-5-leave-in-moisturize-mend-leave-in-conditioner-us) , to support ongoing hydration
- Nourish the scalp with[N°.5 Scalp Longevity Treatment](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-0-5-scalp-longevity-treatment-us) to support the scalp barrier and microbiome


## How Often Should I Moisturize My Hair?


How often you moisturize your hair depends on your hair type, environment, and level of damage. For example, if your hair is very dry and frizzy, you may require daily treatment to keep your hair looking its best.


- For Daily Use: Use lightweight leave-in moisture like[N°.6 Bond Smoother®](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-6-bond-smoother-us)
- For Weekly Use: Apply an[OLAPLEX hair mask](https://olaplex.com/pages/hair-masks)


You can adjust your routine based on climate, styling habits, and how your hair feels.


### Can You Over-Moisturize Your Hair?


Yes, you can over-moisturize your hair. Too much moisture can cause hair to feel overly soft, limp, or lack structure. That’s why balancing hydration with bond repair is essential. OLAPLEX helps maintain that balance, ensuring hair stays strong, resilient, and hydrated for long-term hair health.


## Frequently Asked Questions


###


### Is It Better to Moisturize Wet or Dry Hair?


Moisturizing damp hair is generally best, as water helps products absorb more effectively and seal hydration. Applying conditioners, masks, or leave-in treatments to damp hair supports better moisture retention. ****


###


### How Do I Moisturize Curly Hair?


Curly hair often needs more moisture due to its shape, which makes it harder for natural oils to travel down the strand. To add moisture to curly hair, start with[Nᴼ.4 Bond Maintenance® Shampoo](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-4-bond-maintenance-shampoo-us) and[Nᴼ.5 Bond Maintenance® Conditioner](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-5-bond-maintenance-conditioner-us) . Add the[Rich Hydration Mask](https://olaplex.com/products/rich-hydration-mask-us) once a week in place of conditioner. Follow up with[Nᴼ.5 Leave-In](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-5-leave-in-moisturize-mend-leave-in-conditioner-us) to finish the routine. Limiting heat styling and protecting curls while sleeping can also help preserve moisture.


### How Do I Moisturize Bleached Hair?


Bleached hair benefits from both moisture and bond repair. Start with[Nᴼ.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment](https://olaplex.com/products/n-3plus-complete-repair-treatment) to help repair damage, then follow with the[Weightless Nourishing Mask](https://olaplex.com/products/weightless-nourishing-mask-us) once a week. Leave-in treatments and heat protectants like[Nᴼ.9 Bond Protector Hair Serum](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-9-bond-protector-nourishing-hair-serum-us) can help maintain moisture and protect against further damage.
